subject: Manager briefing: confidential review rollout and silent comms plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Manager briefing: confidential review rollout and silent comms plan

Team —

We need to lock the approach for this year’s performance window. Given the sensitivity of a handful of reorganizations and promotions that are still subject to legal review, I’m proposing a "silent rollout" approach for managers for the first two weeks of the cycle:

- Staggered manager comms (week 0: managers only; week 2: broad comms to org).
- Manager micro-briefs (5–10 min checkpoints) each morning for the first five business days to surface questions.
- A curated manager script (attached: manager_comm_drafts_v2.docx) with redlines where we expect legal/People sign-off.
- A privacy-safe people export for managers (no PII, cohort-level guidance) — PeopleOps to confirm what we can surface.
- Escalation path: manager -> LA (Laura) -> PeopleOps -> Legal.

Timing ask: I need sign-off on the comm script and export template by EOD Monday (Jul 14) so we can lock the manager-only phase beginning Tuesday Jul 15. If we miss that, we lose the two-week buffer.

Attached: manager_comm_drafts_v2.docx, PII_handling_checklist.pdf

If you have concerns about tone or the staging, flag them inline on the Google Doc (link below). I’ll synthesize and circulate a final short deck for Monday’s exec sync.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-silent-rollout-plan

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, People Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Manager briefing: confidential review rollout and silent comms plan

Thanks, Irene — good framing. Quick notes after skimming the comm drafts:

1) Legal/People dependencies: we need a short blurb from Legal clarifying which roles are on hold for public comms. Without that, managers will get inconsistent answers. Can you confirm who from Legal will sign off?

2) Tone: Suggest softening the language in paragraph 2 of the draft; managers will worry about job security language if it's too direct. I highlighted suggested wording in the attached redline (sent to the doc comments as well).

3) Timing: I can get to the redlines and the escalation matrix by EOD Monday, but only if we don't expand the distribution list for the manager-only phase.

I’ve attached a short redlined version to this reply (sent inline in the doc comments).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Partners
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines. Short summary and next steps so we’re aligned before Monday’s exec sync: 

What we agreed:
- Two-week manager-only "silent rollout" beginning Tue Jul 15.
- Manager script updated with Laura’s tone edits and Marcus’s escalation SLA (24 hrs for high-priority items).
- PeopleOps (Pearl Partners) to confirm the privacy-safe export by Monday morning; Gina Olson (g.olson@pearlpartners.com) is on copy.
- Manager talking points in XLSX ready to upload to portal (Marcus).
- Legal sign-off: Laura will coordinate with Legal and confirm any hold roles by Monday COB.

Deliverables & owners:
- Final manager script (Irene) — due Mon Jul 14 12:00 PDT.
- Privacy-safe export template (Pearl Partners) — due Mon Jul 14 10:00 PDT.
- Escalation matrix + SLA (Laura + Marcus) — due Mon Jul 14 16:00 PDT.
- Manager micro-brief schedule (Irene) — final calendar invite Mon Jul 14 EOD.

If we have all of the above by the listed times, we proceed with the manager-only phase on Tue; if not, we default to a single-day manager briefing (no silent rollout).

I’ll circulate a 1-page recap and the calendar invites after I get the export template. Please flag any blockers now.
